subject: Fraud & Scams
title: How to Protect Yourself
description: Learn How to Protect Yourself in one minute.

hook.text: Nobody plans to join a Ponzi scheme. Every victim thought they were making a smart investment.

buildup.text: Verify independently. Check if the firm is registered with regulators like the SEC or FCA.

discovery.text: Ask how returns are generated. If the explanation is vague or complex, that's a red flag.

twist.text: Be wary of consistent returns, pressure to recruit, and resistance to letting you withdraw.

climax.text: The best defense is simple: if it sounds too good to be true, it is.

punchline.text: Skepticism is free. Gullibility costs everything.

quiz.question: What is the first step to protect yourself from a Ponzi scheme?
options: Verify the firm is registered with regulators
